item.title: Oil prices rise and stocks fall as war with Iran advances despite Trump's talk of negotiations
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — With airstrikes still battering Iran and missiles still targeting sites across the Middle East, some of the optimism that sent stocks rallying the day before drained out of Wall Street on Tuesday.

item.title: Oklahoma’s governor picks energy executive Alan Armstrong to fill US Senate seat through end of year
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY (AP) — Oklahoma's governor on Tuesday appointed energy executive Alan Armstrong to serve in the U.S. Senate through the end of the year and finish the term of Republican Markwayne Mullin, the new homeland security secretary .

item.description: An MLA who appeared — via video — in a hoodie sparked criticism from the premier. It's not the first time that fashion choices in the B.C. legislature have come under scrutiny.

item.title: Not working in your desired field? Bridge jobs can still be beneficial to your career
item.description: A bridge job can be more than just a temporary gig while you wait for something better. It brings its own opportunities, and potentially surprise twists in your career.

item.title: A pink veil across the fields: Thousands flock to Greece’s peach blossoms
item.description: VERIA, Greece (AP) — Each spring, a pink veil unfolds across the plains of Greece’s largest peach-producing region.

item.title: National Bank CEO urges Canada to move faster on priorities in 'dangerous' world
item.description: TORONTO — The chief executive of National Bank of Canada says he's not changing the bank's strategy because of the war in the Middle East, but he is urging a faster response from Canada to rising threats abroad.

item.title: Dollarama to only pass on price increases from war where 'absolutely necessary': CEO
item.description: As conflict in the Middle East drives up the cost of many daily essentials, the head of Dollarama Inc. says the company will try to resist hiking its own prices as much as possible.

item.title: New York plane crash investigation looking at cockpit recorder and controllers

item.title: Fire out and shelter-in-place order is lifted after oil refinery explosion near Texas coast

item.title: Pride festivals seek federal $3M as corporations pull back support amid DEI backlash
item.description: OTTAWA — Pride festivals are seeking $3 million annually from Ottawa to fill a funding gap left by organizers pulling back funding amid a backlash to diversity, equity and inclusion programs.
